description: Build an unsigned AeX402 swap (swapt0t1/swapt1t0) on a 2-token pool: the exact quote from aex402_quote, minOutput = quote less slippageBps, the user token accounts derived (classic SPL token), and an idempotent create of the output token account in preInstructions. Sign as userWallet and submit.

amount.description: Input amount in atomic units; a decimal string for values above 2^53

name: aex402_buildSwap

instruction.description: programId, keys, data (base64) — sign & submit client-side

params.description: programId, pool, inputMint, outputMint, amount, estimatedOutput, minOutput (u64 strings), slippageBps, feeBps, priceImpactPct

warning.description: the program pays 1% or more below the curve; omitted when it pays within 1%
